title: The phone number check keeps asking the server every 3 seconds even after it has run out of time
what: After a member taps Check with WhatsApp, the app asks MettleUp every 3 seconds whether the message arrived. When the answer is that the check ran out of time, the number was wrong or too many messages came, the app shows the words but keeps asking every 3 seconds for as long as that screen stays open. A phone left on that screen makes about 1,200 calls an hour, all counted against the free daily request allowance that every gym and member shares.
expected: The asking stops as soon as the check has ended, and it slows down after the first few minutes of waiting.
who: every gym and member through the shared allowance
how_often: whenever a member leaves the screen open after a check ends
fix_line: Stop asking once the check has ended, and ask less often the longer it waits
